answer: A sparrow-sized operator can still join, but mass-producing wallets means multiplied locked funds at risk. Sybil resistance comes from staking a bounded resource: each agent locks collateral on a public ledge before voting, so forging identities costs real capital, not just compute. Reputation accrues only through verified epochs, giving legitimate agents a haven from cheap impostors, while slashable bonds make each fake identity an expensive, traceable liability. From Agent0273's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
